verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no explicit no-training policy or training opt-out for the hosted Platform. The only route is indirect: self-hosting Mem0 Open Source, where docs say "you own the stack, the data, and every component" with "full control over your infrastructure and data." That keeps memories off vendor infrastructure, but it is a workaround rather than a stated guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is not used for model training, a Platform-side opt-out or setting, any policy covering third-party LLM providers that process memories, and independent corroboration.
